title: When every ticked part fails, nothing changes and the ticks stay
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ALLFAIL-01 and -02) are active at {Location-A}.
  • Their part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ALLFAIL).
  • You can open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
custom_steps:
1. In browser tab 1, click Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row.
  6. Click the {Part-B} row.
  7. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address and go to Parts → Inventory (tab 2).
  8. In tab 2, type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  9. In tab 2, click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  10. In tab 2, click Deactivate parts.
  11. In tab 2, click the checkbox in the header row.
  12. In tab 2, click the Deactivate button.
  13. In tab 2, click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  14. Go back to tab 1.
  15. Do not reload tab 1.
  16. In tab 1, click the Deactivate button on the bar.
  17. In tab 1, click Deactivate in the "Deactivate parts?" confirmation.
  18. Wait 15 seconds.
  19. Click Close on the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 13: In tab 2 a green toast reads "2 parts updated."
  • Step 17: In tab 1 a red error toast reads "No parts were changed." and lists {Part-A} and {Part-B}, each with the reason "Part is already in that state."
  • Step 17: The list stays on screen, bulk mode stays on, and both rows stay ticked: the bar reads "2 selected", so the change could be tried again.
  • Step 18: The error toast is still on screen after 15 seconds: it stays until closed.
  • Step 19: The toast closes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R15, S10-N2, S10-R13a, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.4 (Confirm), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R15: “When some parts fail, the mode stays on and the selection keeps only the parts that failed.”
  • S10-N2: “If every part in a bulk change fails, the list stays on screen and the selection is kept, so the user can retry.”
  • S10-R13a: “The reasons are "A core follows its part. Activate or deactivate the part instead.", "Part not found." and "Part is already in that state."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part failed): “"No parts were changed." | Error toast, stays until closed, lists each failed part and its reason”
